procedure: Load a base and a cap into their respective nests on fixture_1. The two loading operations may occur in either order. After both are loaded, seat the cap on the base with a press. Inspect the seated assembly with a camera. Use only the supplied equipment and keep fixture_1 reserved during every operation.
assumptions: All durations are declared toy-model constants, not measured timings.

Geometry, reach, contact, force, sensor accuracy and actual inspection outcomes are not modeled.
